claim: The hybrid DNS whitepaper, which is for historical reference only, gives logging DNS queries as one reason to run your own forwarders. The developer guide history shows that support for Resolver query logs was added on September 1, 2020, and Resolver query logging can log queries that originate in your VPCs, queries from inbound Resolver endpoints and queries that use outbound Resolver endpoints.

evidence.quote: September 1, 2020 Added support for Resolver query logs.
One reason to run your own forwarders is to log DNS queries.
This whitepaper is for historical reference only.

You can log the following DNS queries: Queries that originate in Amazon Virtual Private Cloud VPCs that you specify, as well as the responses to those DNS queries. Queries from on-premises resources that use an inbound Resolver endpoint. Queries that use an outbound Resolver endpoint for recursive DNS resolution.
